content.name: Amira Haddad
content.title: Sales Associate
content.summary: Newly qualified Kauffrau im Einzelhandel (IHK) working as a sales associate in a München outdoor shop. Completed a shortened two-year apprenticeship with a final grade of 1.8 and serves customers in German, English and Arabic, which makes her the go-to person for the store's many international visitors.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Advise 40 to 70 customers a day on hiking boots, alpine clothing and climbing gear, reaching 108% of my personal monthly target on average.
Look after tax-free shopping forms and international customers, serving visitors in English and Arabic during the summer season.
Plan the boot-fitting corner layout with the department manager, which shortened waiting times on Saturdays.

experience.title: Auszubildende Kauffrau im Einzelhandel (retail apprentice)
bullets: Rotated through checkout, goods receiving, ski rental and the sales floor as part of the dual training programme.
Ran the ski rental desk on winter weekends, issuing and checking in up to 120 sets a day.
Prepared a project on reducing returns of online orders for the IHK final exam, later partly adopted by the store.

education.degree: Kauffrau im Einzelhandel (IHK), retail sales qualification, shortened to two years
education.school: Städtische Berufsschule für den Einzelhandel / IHK für München und Oberbayern

achievements.title: Shortened apprenticeship
achievements.detail: Completed the three-year apprenticeship in two years with a final grade of 1.8.

achievements.title: Returns project
achievements.detail: Exam project on online-order returns was used to update the store's size guidance.

interests: Via ferrata routes in the Alps
